# Week 1
## Full Body A
bw / used: none / 3x6 / 0lb / 60s / warmup: none / progress: custom() {~
  if (completedReps >= reps && reps[1] < 12) {
    reps += 1
  }
~}
run / used: none / 1x1 0lb 600s|0s / warmup: none
mobility / used: none / 2x1 0lb 45s|15s / warmup: none

Squat, Bodyweight / ...bw
Push Up / ...bw
// Use a low bar, or lie under a sturdy table and pull your chest to the edge.
Inverted Row / ...bw
Romanian Deadlift, Bodyweight / ...bw
Dead Bug / ...bw
// 10 easy minutes. A jog outside counts too.
High Knee Skips / ...run

## Full Body B
Single Leg Deadlift, Bodyweight / ...bw
Pike Push Up / ...bw
// Hold a door frame, or a towel looped round a post, lean back and pull.
Vertical Row / ...bw
Reverse Lunge, Bodyweight / ...bw
Diamond Push Up / ...bw
// Stand on a step and let the heels drop.
Standing Calf Raise, Bodyweight / ...bw

## Full Body C
Split Squat, Bodyweight / ...bw
// Hands on a table or a bench.
Incline Push Up / ...bw
// Use a low bar, or lie under a sturdy table and pull your chest to the edge.
Wide Row / ...bw
// Shoulders on a couch or a bed.
Hip Thrust, Bodyweight / ...bw
// Sit in a deep squat. Hold a door frame for balance.
Assisted Squat / ...mobility
// Slow, no weight. Sit tall and turn your chest side to side.
Russian Twist / ...mobility
// Slow reach to the floor. Feel the back of the leg.
stretch: Single Leg Deadlift, Bodyweight / ...mobility
